{{Quote|The shuttle departed from a remote island on Ord Mantell. Lorrick has a secret base there.|[[Melarra]]|<ref name="TOR:KUS">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Kaon Under Siege}}</ref>}}
The '''Lost Island''' was an island located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. During the [[Galactic War]], it was the site of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]]'s secret laboratory.<ref name="TOR:OinTH" /><ref name="TOR:TinTH" /> The Lost Island research facilities were [[Mission to the Lost Island|attacked]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]<ref name="TOR:LI">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Lost Island}}</ref> in [[3639 BBY]]<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|1.2}}</ref> because the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] was responsible for the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak]].<ref name="TOR:OinTH" /><ref name="TOR:TinTH" />
